datasets.title: Dataset families
datasets.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT source||char(0)||family) n FROM datasets

bodies.title: Bodies with data
bodies.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT body_id) n FROM dataset_bodies WHERE role='target'

incss.title: Of them in cssEarth
incss.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT l.body_id) n FROM dataset_bodies l JOIN bodies b ON b.id=l.body_id WHERE l.role='target' AND b.cssearth_object<>''

archive.title: Dataset families per archive
archive.query: SELECT CASE source WHEN 'photojournal' THEN 'Photojournal' WHEN 'usgs' THEN 'USGS maps' WHEN 'pds' THEN 'PDS4 bundles' WHEN 'umd' THEN 'Maryland' WHEN 'darts' THEN 'DARTS' WHEN 'opus' THEN 'OPUS' WHEN 'trek' THEN 'NASA Trek' ELSE source END AS archive, count(DISTINCT family) AS datasets FROM datasets GROUP BY archive

kind.title: Dataset families per body kind
kind.query: SELECT CASE b.kind WHEN 'planet' THEN 'Planets' WHEN 'dwarf-planet' THEN 'Dwarf planets' WHEN 'satellite' THEN 'Moons' WHEN 'asteroid' THEN 'Asteroids' WHEN 'trans-neptunian' THEN 'Trans-Neptunian' WHEN 'comet' THEN 'Comets' WHEN 'interstellar' THEN 'Interstellar' WHEN 'star' THEN 'Stars' WHEN 'exoplanet' THEN 'Exoplanets' WHEN 'deep-sky' THEN 'Deep sky' WHEN 'sample' THEN 'Lab samples' WHEN 'calibration' THEN 'Calibration' WHEN 'environment' THEN 'Space environment' WHEN 'group' THEN 'Groups' ELSE 'Unidentified' END AS kind, count(DISTINCT d.source||char(0)||d.family) AS datasets FROM dataset_bodies l JOIN bodies b ON b.id=l.body_id JOIN datasets d ON d.source=l.source AND d.id=l.dataset_id WHERE l.role='target' GROUP BY kind

top.title: Bodies in cssEarth with the most dataset families, by archive
top.query: WITH top AS (SELECT l.body_id FROM dataset_bodies l JOIN bodies b ON b.id=l.body_id JOIN datasets d ON d.source=l.source AND d.id=l.dataset_id WHERE l.role='target' AND b.cssearth_object<>'' GROUP BY l.body_id ORDER BY count(DISTINCT d.source||char(0)||d.family) DESC LIMIT 30) SELECT b.name AS body, CASE l.source WHEN 'photojournal' THEN 'Photojournal' WHEN 'usgs' THEN 'USGS maps' WHEN 'pds' THEN 'PDS4 bundles' WHEN 'umd' THEN 'Maryland' WHEN 'darts' THEN 'DARTS' WHEN 'opus' THEN 'OPUS' ELSE l.source END AS archive, count(DISTINCT d.source||char(0)||d.family) AS datasets FROM dataset_bodies l JOIN bodies b ON b.id=l.body_id JOIN datasets d ON d.source=l.source AND d.id=l.dataset_id WHERE l.role='target' AND l.body_id IN (SELECT body_id FROM top) GROUP BY body, archive

missions.title: Missions with the most dataset families
missions.query: SELECT m.name AS mission, count(DISTINCT d.source||char(0)||d.family) AS datasets FROM dataset_instruments l JOIN instruments i ON i.id=l.instrument_id JOIN missions m ON m.id=i.mission_id JOIN datasets d ON d.source=l.source AND d.id=l.dataset_id GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY datasets DESC LIMIT 25
